column1: # Files in lib/kdb-parquet whose bytes differ from upstream e5cd641c321e (#2157).
# NOT reviewed or accepted: recorded so the gate can hold them where they are
# while the owner decides. They were changed when the tree was vendored
# (f6df10aa), most likely by this repository's own pre-commit hooks - trailing-whitespace,
# end-of-file-fixer, mixed-line-ending - which ran over lib/ until lib/ was
# excluded from them. kind "whitespace": the change is only trailing spaces or
# tabs, a CR, or blank lines and the newline at the end of the file. kind
# "edit": anything else; see the vendoring commit's message.
# To revert to upstream: python3 scripts/dev/revendor.py kdb-parquet
# (which deletes this file). To accept a change as a patch instead, it stays
# listed here with a reason. The gate fails if any listed file changes again.
